decision: Do not ship the functional status adapter from this experiment.
reason: Claude Code 2.1.271 accepted the function-hook API and mixed hook manifest statically, but isolated startup stopped before the prompt loop. Live trigger, fallback, context-retention and comparative latency cells are NO_DATA, so the predeclared benefit over native shell mode is unproven.
failureDetail: Every isolated interactive launch exited before input with an Anthropic connectivity error; a local base-URL stub received no request.
limitations: Static validation does not prove runtime hook execution.
The direct command is not an interactive native-shell measurement.
No claim is made that function hooks are unsupported; the experiment failed its proof threshold.
Reconsider only with a safe live 2.1.271 runtime probe and a predeclared measurable advantage over native shell mode.
